issues.description: patch_description does not follow the standard format '0001 <description with spaces>' per code style rule R12. The current value 'Replace target_compile_features with set_target_properties for HMDFS compatibility' omits the 4-digit sequence number prefix ('0001'). The rule example shows '"0001 build aux config.guess"'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change patch_description to start with the sequence number: "0001 Replace target_compile_features with set_target_properties for HMDFS compatibility"

issues.description: Absolute paths in patch_generation section (source_orig_dir, source_work_dir) reference local build machine paths (/storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/...). These are metadata from the build process, not part of the recipe, but could expose machine-specific paths.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider using relative paths or replacing with build-environment-agnostic placeholders in the patch_generation metadata section.

issues.description: archive_path field contains an absolute local path (/storage/Users/currentUser/.opendesk/apps/skills/...). This is metadata, not part of the recipe, but exposes machine-specific path.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider removing the archive_path field or replacing with a relative path from the repository root.

issues.description: Unused includes: <cstdlib> and <string> are included but not directly referenced in the code. No cstdlib functions (exit, malloc, etc.) or std::string usage is present.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove '#include <cstdlib>' and '#include <string>' since they are not needed by any code in the test.

issues.description: Inconsistent string quoting: some string values are quoted (homepage, upstream_check_command, descriptions, commands) while others are not (package: glog/0.7.1, file: src/logging_unittest.cc, source: glog-0.7.1/src/logging_unittest.cc). For consistency, all string values in YAML should be quoted.
issues.fix_suggestion: Quote all string values consistently, e.g., package: "glog/0.7.1", file: "src/logging_unittest.cc", source: "glog-0.7.1/src/logging_unittest.cc".

summary:
Re-audit of glog 0.7.1 Conan recipe after fixes. VERDICT: PASS. No P0 (deception) or P1 (correctness) issues found.

P0 Deception checks — ALL PASSED:
- R34 Empty shell test: test_package/src/main.cpp calls real glog API (google::InitGoogleLogging, LOG(INFO/WARNING/ERROR), CHECK_EQ, VLOG, google::ShutdownGoogleLogging). Not a printf-only stub.
- R9 Skip/fake test: test_package/conanfile.py test() runs the actual test_glog binary via self.run(). Not a pass-through.
- Fake status: manifest.yaml and _meta.yaml both consistently show status='built'. Not falsely marked as published.
- Fake sha256: conandata.yml sha256 is '00e4a87e87b7e7612f519a41e491f16623b12423620006f59f5688bfd8d13b08' (64 hex chars, not all-zeros/all-f).
- R8 #ifdef __OHOS__ stub: No empty #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs in patches or source.
- R19 Manual binary: No pre-compiled .so/.a/binary files in PR.
- R40 Deep adaptation: glog is a logging library, not in R40 deep-adaptation categories (graphics/UI/multimedia/hardware/system-level).

P1 Correctness checks — ALL PASSED:
- R33 Hardcoded compiler paths: None. Uses CMakeToolchain(self) properly.
- R32 OHOS platform check: 'if self.settings.os in ("Linux", "OHOS")' uses 'in', not '=='.
- R39 Official source URL: https://github.com/google/glog/archive/v0.7.1.tar.gz (official Google GitHub repo). No manual mirror URLs.
- R37 Version numbering: 0.7.1 is upstream version for first adaptation.
- Conan 2.x API: Uses 'from conan import ConanFile', 'conan.tools.cmake'. No legacy 'from conans'.
- package_info(): Properly sets cpp_info.libs=['glog'], cmake target/file names, defines, system_libs.
- requirements(): Conditionally requires gflags/2.2.2.
- Patch 0001: Real and meaningful — replaces target_compile_features with set_target_properties for HMDFS compatibility.
- test_package/MANIFEST.yml: Has real upstream test declarations and test_package test declarations.
- No hardcoded absolute paths in test code.
- No unfilled template placeholders in notes.md (no TODO, FIXME, or (请填写)).
- Version strings quoted in YAML files (conandata.yml, manifest.yaml, _meta.yaml).
- url='' in conanfile.py is by-design template pattern (CI fills this) — not flagged per audit instructions.

Minor issues (P2/P3) — 5 items, all non-blocking:
- P2 (1): conandata.yml patch_description missing '0001' sequence number prefix per R12 format.
- P3 (4): metadata absolute paths in manifest.yaml/_meta.yaml (build process artifacts), unused includes in main.cpp, inconsistent YAML string quoting in MANIFEST.yml.
